apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: sistema-noticias-statefulset
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: sistema-noticias
  template:
    metadata:
      name: sistema-noticias
      labels:
        app: sistema-noticias
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: sistema-noticias
        image: aluracursos/sistema-noticias:1
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: sistema-noticias-config-map
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /var/www/html/uploads
          name: imagens-pvc
        - mountPath: /tmp
          name: sessao-pvc
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 128Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 256Mi
        securityContext:
          privileged: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
            - NET_RAW
            - NET_ADMIN
            - SYS_ADMIN
            - SYS_MODULE
            - SYS_PTRACE
            - SYS_CHROOT
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          runAsNonRoot: true
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
      volumes:
      - name: imagens-pvc
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: imagens-pvc
      - name: sessao-pvc
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: sessao-pvc
